rules.title: San Francisco annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units (3/1/2026 - 2/28/2027)
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units in San Francisco, the annual allowable rent increase from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent.
rules.coverage_conditions: Rent-controlled residential units in San Francisco. The document does not define which units are rent-controlled.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Applies only to units that are rent-controlled under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance. The document does not state the coverage criteria.

rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board annual allowable increase announcement (San Francisco Rent Ordinance)
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.conflict_note: The amount resets annually. The prior period (3/1/2025 - 2/28/2026) was 1.4%. The document gives no ordinance section citation or coverage criteria for rent-controlled units.
